answers.core: Both containers are part of the core widgets.
answers.workaround: It depends: on projects that do not rely much on class and scene inheritance (like many use just ducktyping), it would be enough to just create a new scene with the desired layout. On the other side instead, it is not possible because to workaround this problem is required to rewrite a lot of code that it is really the same, but with a different container. So it would require to keep the "two branches" synchronized, that is very error prone and time wasting.
